title: Redstone Overhaul - Animated
description: Animated redstone textures for dust, lamps, rails, and ores to make Minecraft circuits feel more alive while keeping the vanilla style.
body:
Redstone Overhaul – Animated Edition improves Minecraft redstone visuals with smooth animated textures and enhanced effects.

This pack upgrades redstone dust, repeaters, comparators, redstone lamps, rails, observers, and redstone ore with subtle animations that make redstone circuits feel more dynamic and alive.

The pack is designed to stay close to the vanilla Minecraft style while adding clean visual improvements for a more immersive gameplay experience, especially in dark caves and technical builds.
